entradas.text: He laughed.
“President Rayne. Welcome to Perla.”
“Thank you. It's good to be here, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you. It's good to be here, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “Good to have you here. I hear a lot about your successes.”
“And I hear a lot about your successes as well, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “And I hear a lot about your successes as well, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “Who doesn't?”
entradas.menu: “Who doesn't?”

entradas.text: “I hope you had a nice trip.”
“I try, Mr. Rayne.”
“Confidence is a rare quality, Mr. Rayne.”
I smelled the strong odor of alcohol.
“Have you been drinking?”
entradas.menu: “Have you been drinking?”

entradas.text: I didn't say anything.
entradas.menu: Don't say anything.

entradas.text: “A couple of glasses of the finest Lespian wine is the best way to start any meeting.”
“Would you like some?”
“No, thank you.”
entradas.menu: “No, thank you.”

entradas.text: “Since you asked, why not?”
entradas.menu: “Since you asked, why not?”

entradas.text: “You are speaking to a President. Where is your professionalism?”
entradas.menu: “You are speaking to a President. Where is your professionalism?”

entradas.text: “Let's begin then.”
He cleared his throat.
“Very well.”
He gestured to the assistants.
“Two glasses.”
They came back very fast. We took a sip.
“Ah. Nothing like it.”
“So, you are here for the trade deal.”
“What was it about again? Can you remind me?”
“Right.”
“Mr. Alvarez. Are you making fun of me right now?”
entradas.menu: “Mr. Alvarez. Are you making fun of me right now?”

entradas.text: “We want to provide Sordish fishing output in return for Lespian capital.”
entradas.menu: “We want to provide Sordish fishing output in return for Lespian capital.”

entradas.text: “We want to provide Sordish wheat in return for Lespian capital.”
entradas.menu: “We want to provide Sordish wheat in return for Lespian capital.”

entradas.text: “We want to provide Sordish coal in return for Lespian capital.”
entradas.menu: “We want to provide Sordish coal in return for Lespian capital.”

entradas.text: “We want to provide Sordish tungsten in return for Lespian capital.”
entradas.menu: “We want to provide Sordish tungsten in return for Lespian capital.”

entradas.text: “No. Absolutely not.”
“I have just been very busy lately.”
“You know...being the Prime Minister makes you pretty busy.”
“Ah. Yes. Right.”
“Sorry. I have just been very busy lately.”
“So, I don't have any issues with this deal.”
“Except there is one problem.”
“You know...being the Prime Minister makes you pretty busy.”
He pulled out a few documents from his briefcase and started inspecting them.
“Wehlen.”
He smirked.
“Your decision to defend the border while Smolak committed war crimes diverted all those refugees here.”
“Now we have a full-blown refugee crisis in Lespia.”
“Which unfortunately means that the price has gone up, Mr. Rayne.”
“Your decision to join Smolak in his attack against the unfortunate Bludish population compromised a lot of the Lespian assets in the area.”
“This has negatively affected Lespia. Our economy was indirectly hit due to the destruction of manufacturing sites. In particular the oil refineries.”
“No. The price will stay the same or there won't be any deal.”
entradas.menu: “No. The price will stay the same or there won't be any deal.”

entradas.text: “Tell me what you want, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “Tell me what you want, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “Makes sense. I knew this was coming. So what is on the new price tag?”
entradas.menu: “Makes sense. I knew this was coming. So what is on the new price tag?”

entradas.text: “It is your choice.”
“Just like it was your choice to leave Bludish people alone to fend for themselves.”
“Reminds me of Soll in many ways. What was it? Ah yes. The Soll Dam Incident.”
“Good intuition.”
“The only thing anyone could possibly ever want out of Wehlen.”
“I want their oil.”
“And how are you planning to get that?”
entradas.menu: “And how are you planning to get that?”

entradas.text: “I'm listening.”
entradas.menu: “I'm listening.”

entradas.text: “A lot of oil from Wehlen is passing through Sordland.”
“And Sordish Petroleum owns most of the oil trade in Sordland.”
“Do you see where I am going with that?”
“Yes, I do.”
entradas.menu: “Yes, I do.”

entradas.text: “Enlighten me.”
entradas.menu: “Enlighten me.”

entradas.text: “I want you to sell me Sordish Petroleum or the deal is off.”
“There is no way I can do that.”
entradas.menu: “There is no way I can do that.”

entradas.text: “Very well. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. I accept.” [-1 Government Budget]

entradas.text: “You really are a shrewd man, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “You really are a shrewd man, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “I will take that as a compliment.”
“Then thank you for coming this far to visit Perla.”
He got up and started making his way to the door.
“Wait. Fine. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Wait. Fine. I accept.” [-1 Government Budget]

entradas.text: He turned around with a smile and opened his arms.
“My favorite phrase in this world. 'I accept.'.”
We shook hands.
I let him go without saying anything.
entradas.menu: Let him go.

entradas.text: “I think it will contribute nicely to the relationship between Lespia and Sordland.”
“I do, however, believe that we can do much more than just trade.”
“We...by we, I mean ATO...”
“...Would like to see Sordland in our sphere.”
“What do you think, Mr. Rayne?”
“Thank you for the offer but that is not one of our aims for now.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you for the offer but that is not one of our aims for now.”

entradas.text: “Why would you do that for Sordland? What's in it for you?”
entradas.menu: “Why would you do that for Sordland? What's in it for you?”

entradas.text: “That sounds excellent. How do we begin?”
entradas.menu: “That sounds excellent. How do we begin?”

entradas.text: “Just the answer I wanted to hear!”
“Prosperity in Eastern Merkopa!”
“Remedying old alliances!”
“And most importantly, forming a defensive pact against United Contana.”
“For now...maybe.”
“But where will you stand when United Contana attacks Eastern Merkopa, as it surely will?”
“That is the real question.”
“We need to form a defensive pact against United Contana in Eastern Merkopa before it's too late.”
“They will attack eventually.”
“Those damn communists!”
“We need to stop them before it's too late.”
“Valgsland, those barbarians, are preparing to invade Heljiland on false accusations.”
“If Agnolia is first, Sordland will be next.”
“I will be frank. Eastern Merkopa's only way to survival is through ATO.”
“Are you with us?”
“Will you defend our continent against the blight of communism?”
“Down with the communists. I am willing to do whatever it takes to protect Sordland.”
entradas.menu: “Down with the communists. I am willing to do whatever it takes to protect Sordland.”

entradas.text: “I think you are exaggerating the threat. I have my doubts about this.”
entradas.menu: “I think you are exaggerating the threat. I have my doubts about this.”

entradas.text: “I can't decide without knowing what is in it for me.”
entradas.menu: “I can't decide without knowing what is in it for me.”

entradas.text: “I see that you possess the mind of a man who understands business.”
“I offer you an alliance. It will come with a special aid package from me.”
“Together we will shield the continent against Malenyev's evil.”
“Not to mention that you will have Arcasia's full backing. The most powerful ally you can have in this era.”
“I am giving you this option for your country's own good, Mr. Rayne.”
“Well said! First, Hegel will fall. Then Malenyev!”
“I accept. Sordland will be allied to Lespia.”
entradas.menu: “I accept. Sordland will be allied to Lespia.” [+2 Government Budget]

entradas.text: “I have to refuse. I will not drag Sordland into an international conflict.”
entradas.menu: “I have to refuse. I will not drag Sordland into an international conflict.”

entradas.text: “I am overjoyed. This is a start to bring our countries closer than ever before.”
“We Eastern Merkopans should stand together.”
“Speaking of standing together...I want to talk to you about something.”
He clenched his fist and slammed it on the coffee table.
“And we need the support of one of the largest players in Eastern Merkopa. Sordland.”
“The beautiful country of Sordland is the key to all of this. We need you, Mr. Rayne. We need Sordland.”
“You think you are evading the conflict by trying to stay neutral.”
“Remember my words when the conflict is at your doorstep, ringing your doorbell, Mr. Rayne.”
“Perfect! Brilliant!”
“You don't know how valuable you are, Mr. Rayne!”
“You just saved your country from its demise.”
“I will personally talk to Mr. Walker to let him know of this achievement.”
We shook hands and he went in for a hug. I could smell the alcohol on his breath.
“Don't forget that I gave you a choice.”
“I can just say that I hope Sordland doesn't fall into a bad position because of your decision.”
“I will sign the executive order.”
“Not to mention the humanitarian implications. We had to do our duty and send aid to those who were displaced as a result.”
“Take care of your own country's issues first, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “Take care of your own country's issues first, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “I would recommend you not to badmouth Colonel Soll.”
entradas.menu: “I would recommend you not to badmouth Colonel Soll.”

entradas.text: “I had to make a hard decision and this is the result of it.”
entradas.menu: “I had to make a hard decision and this is the result of it.”

entradas.text: “Not every hard decision is right, Mr. Rayne.”
“I am doing exactly that right now.”
“My apologies. I never took you for a Sollist.”
“Before you make your final decision, let me tell you about my offer.”
“I want the only thing that anyone could possibly ever want out of Wehlen.”
“And?”
entradas.menu: “And?”

entradas.text: He looked at the clock.
“I'm afraid I have to leave now to attend to other matters.”
“Thank you for your visit.”
“Before I forget.”
On his way to the door, he suddenly turned around.
“You owe me a teapot.”
He smiled and left the room.
On his way to the door, he suddenly turned around.
“Before I forget.”
He left the room and an assistant arrived to escort me.
“You owe me a teapot.”
“Our energy protection laws don't allow such actions. I can't comply Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “Our energy protection laws don't allow such actions. I can't comply Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “Shrewd but not investigative enough. The Energy Protection Act doesn't allow such a transaction.”
entradas.menu: “Shrewd but not investigative enough. The Energy Protection Act doesn't allow such a transaction.”

entradas.text: “Goodbye.”
entradas.menu: “Goodbye.”

entradas.text: “Very well. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. I accept.”

entradas.text: “Very well. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. I accept.”
